verdict.rationale: Access certification is a fair axis for an identity and access management product like Okta, so the story applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents certification campaigns, reviewer routing, scheduled re-justification, or audit-ready sign-off records. The nearest items are MCP server prompts for listing users and unused applications, and event hooks, which are adjacent features and do not deliver access reviews.

support.subject: As a security engineer, access gets re-justified on a schedule — certification campaigns route who-has-what to reviewers and produce audit-ready sign-off records
